items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: This fella, Reed, he brought you Norm Good, too. I seen his name in the book yesterday

ctx.x: Oh. They sang with the blues? Huh? They sang the blues first then? Yeah. Mm-hmm. And, uh...
This fella, Reed, he brought you Norm Good, too. I seen his name in the book yesterday, uh... Edward Clem. You know Edward Clem.
I've heard of him plenty. Uh-huh. I've heard of him plenty. Ernest Rogers used to talk about him. Yeah, Ernest. Ernest used to play with you.
